title: RAW UNREVIEWED: f88r's three illustrated rows form a process or three independent entries
summary: The admitted f88r page has three visibly separate rows of vessels and plant fragments and three prose blocks (GDT791's page inventory); its sixteen local label groups are distributed across those rows. Freeze the image-row boundaries, complete prose blocks and all label owners before assigning any material or action meaning. A serial-process reading must carry one explicitly written participant or resulting state from row 1 into row 2 and then row 3, with each step changing it; an independent-entry reading introduces a fresh owner in each block and permits repeated formulae without material handoff. Require an overt text bridge beyond repeated common words and a separately traced visible relationship between rows; if either is absent, record no capacity. Earlier sidequest batch paraphrases are exploratory and provide no binding.

design.mechanism: three physically separate illustrated rows and three owned prose blocks may encode one continuing material history
design.unit: all three admitted f88r image rows, their sixteen local labels and three complete prose blocks
design.contrast: serial transformation with overt row-to-row participant carry versus three independent pharmaceutical entries
design.prediction: a frozen serial reading preserves one overt participant through two transitions and explains a visible row relationship; absent independent linkage means no semantic test
